Dear Linux Mint / Ubuntu users,

If you get an error on bootup stating "Disk Filter Writes are not supported" after installing a Raid configuration under Ubuntu 14.04 / Linux Mint 17+ editions there is a correct solution to this issue.

Do not set quick_boot="0" as this only masks the problem but doesn't solve it. It also disables some functionality as well.

The correct solution was taken from http://askubuntu.com/questions/468466/diskfilter-writes-are-not-supported-what-triggers-this-error

Open up Terminal and enter to the commands in the following sequence:

sudo wget https://gist.githubusercontent.com/rarylson/da6b77ad6edde25529b2/raw/99f266a10e663e1829efc25eca6eddb9412c6fdc/00_header_patched

sudo mv /etc/grub.d/00_header /etc/grub.d/00_header.orig

sudo mv 00_header_patched /etc/grub.d/00_header

sudo chmod -x /etc/grub.d/00_header.orig

sudo chmod +x /etc/grub.d/00_header

sudo update-grub

**All credit goes to the guy that made this solution possible. ** As a Linux Mint user there are just so many little annoyances that plague the OS but it's very difficult to find a solution for some things so I'm going to help out users any way I can based on my experience.
Correct solution to Disk Filter Writes are not supported
